name: Neural Articulated Radiance Field (NARF)
definition: A method trained via pose-annotated images where an articulated object is decomposed into several rigid object parts with local coordinate systems and global shape variations.
summary: Neural Articulated Radiance Field models articulated objects by decomposing them into rigid parts, each represented by a separate Rigidly Transformed Neural Radiance Field, and combines them using a differentiable softmax operation.
